title: Workload Handoff (Per Namespace)
description: Per-namespace narrower version of workload-handoff.json. One file per cluster per namespace under workload-handoff/<cluster>/<namespace>/.

target_cluster_name.description: Placeholder. Populated by gke-landing-zone when target is decided.

name.description: Exact Kubernetes resource metadata.name of the workload (e.g., Deployment or StatefulSet). Do not use container names or label values.

autopilot_compatible.description: Heuristic: false if hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC, privileged containers, added capabilities, or hostPath volumes.

pod_security_baseline_passes.description: Heuristic: false if hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC, privileged containers, or hostPath volumes.

images.description: Full container image references including registry, repo, and tag/digest.

irsa_role_arn.description: Resolved from IRSA SA annotation OR Pod Identity association. Null if neither applies.

service_account.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount name. 'default' if not explicitly set.

http_routes.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute references in 'namespace/name' format.

secrets.description: Kubernetes Secret names consumed by this workload (env, envFrom, volumes, imagePullSecrets).

configmaps.description: Kubernetes ConfigMap names consumed by this workload.

services.description: Kubernetes Service metadata.names targeting this workload via label selector matching.

data_dependencies.description: RDS/ElastiCache/etc. identifiers. Populated by Step 9 cross-reference.

pvc_names.description: PersistentVolumeClaim metadata.names referenced by this workload.

volume_claim_templates.description: PersistentVolumeClaim template names dynamically provisioned by StatefulSets.

rwx_file_shares.description: EFS access points or other RWX shares. Populated by Step 8 cross-reference.
